translation:
Let T be the arithmetic theory obtained by adding to Peano arithmetic (PA) the single axiom given by the formal negation of the standard consistency sentence for Craig's Δ₁ presentation of PA (that is, T = PA ∪ {∼(¬Prov_{PA.craig}(⌜⊥⌝))}, where for any recursively enumerable arithmetic theory F, its consistency sentence is formed as ¬Prov_{F.craig}(⌜⊥⌝) from Craig's Δ₁-presented version of F). Target is the proposition asserting that:
1. T is recursively enumerable;
2. for every set K of arithmetic sentences, if every sentence in K is true in the standard model of arithmetic (the natural numbers), then there exists an arithmetic sentence σ such that σ is a theorem of T (derivable from T in classical first-order logic) and σ is not in K; and
3. there exists a set K of arithmetic sentences such that:
   (a) there exists a recursively enumerable arithmetic theory F whose set of theorems (in classical first-order logic) equals K,
   (b) every sentence in K is true in the standard model of arithmetic,
   (c) K is closed under classical first-order deduction (every arithmetic sentence derivable from K belongs to K),
   (d) every theorem of PA belongs to K, and
   (e) the standard consistency sentence for Craig's Δ₁ presentation of T (namely ¬Prov_{T.craig}(⌜⊥⌝), formed using the recursive enumerability of T from (1)) belongs to K.

divergences.description: The consistency sentence Def7 F is defined via Craig's trick (F.craig.consistent.val) from a noncomputably chosen RE enumeration of F, rather than from a canonical Δ₁ presentation of PA and PA ∪ {¬Con(PA)}, and Def9 adjoins the classically equivalent double-negated form ∼(¬Prov_{PA.craig}(⌜⊥⌝)) rather than Prov_{PA}(⌜⊥⌝). Because consistency sentences are intensional (presentation-dependent), this is a technical representation choice, though standard for defining consistency uniformly on arbitrary RE theories.

judgement.summary: The TARGET states exactly (i) and (ii) for the recursively enumerable system PA ∪ {∼Con(PA)}, and (i) and (ii) together directly contradict the set-level reading of Corradini and Galvan's corollary by instantiating (i) at the sound mind K witnessed by (ii). The only caveat is the minor technical choice of expressing consistency statements uniformly via Craig's Δ₁ re-axiomatization.
